scenes.say: Gold drops ten dollars – and your account is empty?

scenes.text: Move a big position with little money. Gains and losses grow with it.
scenes.say: Leverage: little capital, big position. Losses included.

scenes.title: STEP 01 · Example
scenes.say: Step one: With leverage of one to five hundred, eight hundred dollars buys one lot.

scenes.label: STEP 02 · Example
scenes.say: Step two: Ten dollars down – minus one thousand. Account gone.

scenes.text: Leverage is only permission. Your risk sets the position size – not your free margin.
scenes.say: Step three: Leverage is just permission. Your risk sets the size.

scenes.text: “I still have free margin – so one more trade fits.”
scenes.say: Typical mistake: Free margin doesn't mean one more trade.

scenes.title: Leverage is a tool, not a turbo.
scenes.say: I show my planning live in my free group. Comment GOLD.
